title: Review and configure Todoist for Bessie via API; temporary files in scratchpad only
body: No vault files edited. Token held in a scratchpad file and deleted afterwards.

cmd: shale intent "Review and configure Todoist for Bessie via API; temporary files in scratchpad only" --body "No vault files edited. Token held in a scratchpad file and deleted afterwards."

cd /private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/03de150e-c04a-441d-9e17-92ec0f08f7d3/scratchpad && chmod 600 bessie.curlrc && curl -sS -K bessie.curlrc -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -o bessie_sync.json https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/sync --data-urlencode 'sync_token=*' --data-urlencode 'resource_types=["all"]' && jq 'to_entries | map({k:.key, n:(.value|if type=="array" or type=="object" then length else . end)})' -c bessie_sync.json | head -c 3000

cd /private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/03de150e-c04a-441d-9e17-92ec0f08f7d3/scratchpad && jq '{user: (.user|{id,full_name,email,is_premium,premium_status,start_page,start_day,days_off,weekend_start_day,daily_goal,date_format,time_format,tz_info,lang,inbox_project_id,auto_reminder,theme_id,default_reminder,verification_status}), user_settings, limits: .user_plan_limits.current, projects: [.projects[]|{id,name,shared,inbox_project,is_archived,is_deleted,view_style,parent_id,role,is_favorite,color}], sections: [.sections[]|{id,project_id,name,section_order,is_archived}], items: [.items[]|{id,project_id,section_id,parent_id,content,description,due,labels,priority,responsible_uid,assigned_by_uid,added_by_uid,checked,added_at,duration}], labels:[.labels[]|{name,color}], filters:[.filters[]|{name,query,is_favorite,is_deleted}], view_options, defaults: .project_view_options_defaults, collaborators:[.collaborators[]|{id,full_name,email}], collaborator_states, reminders, calendars:[.calendars[]|{name:(.summary//.name)}], notifications:[.live_notifications[]|{notification_type,project_name,project_id,item_content,state,is_unread,created_at}]}' bessie_sync.json

cd /private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/03de150e-c04a-441d-9e17-92ec0f08f7d3/scratchpad && echo PROJECTS; jq -c '.projects[]|{id,name,shared,role,view_style,inbox:.inbox_project,fav:.is_favorite,arch:.is_archived}' bessie_sync.json; echo SECTIONS; jq -c '.sections[]|select(.is_deleted|not)|{id,p:.project_id,name}' bessie_sync.json; echo ITEMS; jq -c '.items[]|{id,p:.project_id,s:.section_id,content,desc:.description,due:(.due|if . then {date,string,is_recurring} else null end),labels,priority,resp:.responsible_uid,by:.added_by_uid,parent:.parent_id,checked}' bessie_sync.json

cd /private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/03de150e-c04a-441d-9e17-92ec0f08f7d3/scratchpad && echo '== Family Chores completed since 1 Sep'; curl -sS -K bessie.curlrc -G https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/tasks/completed/by_completion_date --data-urlencode since=2026-09-01T00:00:00Z --data-urlencode until=2026-11-25T23:59:59Z --data-urlencode limit=50 | jq -c '.items[]|{content,project_id,completed_at}' | head -20; jq -c '.completed_info' bessie_sync.json; echo '== docs'; curl -sSL --max-time 30 https://developer.todoist.com/api/v1/ -o docs.html; grep -oE '.{0,40}start_page.{0,600}' docs.html | sed 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' | head -c 2500 # nav-ok

cd /private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/03de150e-c04a-441d-9e17-92ec0f08f7d3/scratchpad && cat > apply.py <<'EOF'
import json, uuid
q = "assigned to: me & (today | overdue), assigned to: me & no date, assigned to: me & date after: today"
print(json.dumps([
 {"type":"filter_update","uuid":str(uuid.uuid4()),"args":{"id":"2365773026","name":"My chores","query":q,"is_favorite":True}},
 {"type":"user_update","uuid":str(uuid.uuid4()),"args":{"start_page":"filter?id=2365773026"}},
]))
EOF
ok=1; for q in 'assigned to: me & (today | overdue)' 'assigned to: me & no date' 'assigned to: me & date after: today'; do r=$(curl -sS -K bessie.curlrc -G -w ' HTTP %{http_code}' https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/tasks/filter --data-urlencode "query=$q"); echo "$q => $r" | head -c 400; echo; [[ $r == *'HTTP 200' ]] || ok=0; done
if [ $ok = 1 ]; then curl -sS -K bessie.curlrc https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/sync --data-urlencode "commands=$(python3 -I apply.py)" | jq -c '.sync_status'; fi
echo '== verify'; curl -sS -K bessie.curlrc https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/sync --data-urlencode 'sync_token=*' --data-urlencode 'resource_types=["filters","user"]' | jq -c '{start_page:.user.start_page, filters:[.filters[]|select(.is_deleted|not)|{name,query,is_favorite}]}'
